questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Easy, but not very flexible.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: If I was only going to take Master courses it was easy - I would just inform the cordinator about which courses I liked, and then I would get them. However, on the Master they have trimester structure instead of semester structure and most of the courses seemed similar to Bachelor courses at KU. Therefore it might be necessary to take courses at other Masters or at the Bachelor level. I got enrolled in these after some weeks.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Only guidance from the cordinator. Online it is not clear which courses are available for Master students but the cordinator can provide this.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: At the end I got the classes I wanted but it took almost a month.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be aware of Bachelor and Master courses - you can not easily swap even though KU allows it.
